Give short answers to the following questions: (i) Explain two reasons why God tested Abraham’s faith. (ii) State two reasons Israelites feared the wilderness. (iii) Give two consequences of idolatry. (iv) Explain two roles of prophets. (v) Mention two leadership failures of Saul. (vi) State two strengths of David’s character.
